Root Scope: Organizations that are cooperative partners of CERT@VDE.
CNA Scope: Products of CERT@VDE cooperative partners and brands listed at https://cert.vde.com/en/cna/. Root Scope: European Union (EU) member states/EU authorities, EU CSIRTs network members, and cooperative partners under ENISA’s mandate as well as other CNAs who choose ENISA as their Root.
